methodology: Offline evaluation on EMPLOYEE users with an active resume embedding and at least one holdout relevant vacancy. Ground-truth relevance: union of saved vacancies (SavedVacancy), job applications (Response), and behaviour events VACANCY_SAVED / VACANCY_APPLIED. Holdout: most recent 20% of relevant vacancies per user (minimum 1) excluded from behaviour profile when ranking; metrics computed on holdout only. Recommendations: production getTopRecommendations hybrid rank (semantic cosine + behaviour), top 10. Per user: Precision@10 = |recommended∩holdout|/10; Recall@10 = |recommended∩holdout|/|holdout|. Reported values: arithmetic mean across evaluated users.
